response.reply:
I understand how frustrating it is to have the tank alert keep cycling on and off even after you've reinstalled the reservoir more than once.

For the Omni E25 (T2353), the error 3021 "sewage tank not in place" is triggered when the robot detects the dirty water reservoir has been removed or isn't seated properly. The knowledge we have links base-station communication problems to radar interference, but that guidance is for base station tasks not starting, not specifically for a repeating tank-removed alert, so I don't want to hand you a fix that isn't confirmed for this symptom. I also can't confirm your warranty status from the information here. [1]

Could you tell me whether the tank alert appears while the robot is docked on the base station or also when it's away from it? That will help me narrow down the right next step, and if it keeps recurring we can route this to a human specialist for review.
